propositions: MCP server must be required for all rebar tracker operations except local-code operations (testing, investigation, debugging, validation).
Certified operations consist only of plan-review and completion-verifier, which are MCP-routed and enforceable via trusted-env when enabled, not code-review.
Code review is the Gerrit LLM-Review vote, not an operation-certificate, and should not be documented as one.

AGENTS.md must serve as an umbrella policy that governs downstream guidance surfaces (docs/, templates/, .agents/rules/, packaged guides, example skills) by reference rather than requiring individual rewrite of each.

docs/mcp-auth.md §7 must document the AWS deployment recipe with the ADR-decided config keys (nginx TLS edge, static verifier, per-client bearer) and link to mcp-client-setup.md for client configuration shapes.
Certified-op enforcement must be described as deferred and enableable via the trusted-env mechanism, with citation to the operator flip runbook, not claimed as live.
